objective:
Take this network from 3rd to 1st on Paradigm's Prediction Market challenge (https://www.paradigm.xyz/puzzles/prediction-market-challenge), in rounds that build on each other instead of one wave of separate attempts.

A Python class quotes passive limit orders on one simulated binary market, scored by mean edge over 200 simulations. Simulator and rules: https://github.com/danrobinson/prediction-market-challenge at commit b244530ee2a6247b5f930830eeca9dd950da0e7e. Run it single-process without --sandbox: --workers is refused on some machines and --sandbox fails on Python 3.12.

Standing on 2026-11-05: 3rd of 186 at 104.84 (retail 128.63, arbitrage -23.79). First 109.59 (130.77, -21.18), second 109.43 (127.73, -18.31). The gap is mostly arbitrage loss.

Start from wave 3's best, combine-cash, +2.08 paired holdout gain (standard error 0.41) over the base: https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/ecbc9087b4f238fc1b5b0d52f55af073f676c038bfb6756172b1e51480ac1741 . Independent alternative, simplify: https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/5aa77c807417d8eb4743635be24fb9590f57e3e636dfb11050dd283e0a14ad6d . The base: https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/5ec4e47200eb5e16cec281f133e5e7fbfd73b3157fcf5f2c60d013ffa9300b76 . How to run the rounds:
- Keep a scoreboard in your notes: the current best's code hash, and each candidate's paired difference against it.
- Every item measures against the current best on the same seeds, paired, with a standard error, and its tuning seeds never overlap its holdout. One 200-run mean has a standard error near 12, so only paired differences over thousands of seeds rank candidates.
- Keep seeds 900000 to 903999 untouched for finalists, run only by your measure items. Promote a new best only when its paired gain there exceeds twice its standard error.
- Split each round: about 40% combine and deepen what the scoreboard says works, 30% fresh mechanisms, 15% take away, 15% measure and replicate. Fresh items read none of the files above and look for one mechanism the best lacks. Wave 3 measured knowing the next step's probability as worth +24 and retail parameters +1: probability and jump estimation, and less arbitrage loss, are the levers.
- No two items in a round try the same idea; name each item's idea in its brief.
- Each item returns JSON: approach, tried, next, code, code_sha256, its tuning score, and its paired difference with standard error.
- Stop after two rounds in a row with no promotion, or at the last episode.

Write-up: the best strategy's full code, ready to submit, its evidence on the finalist seeds, and a ranked table of every promotion.
